evidence_class: previously unselected released-data development evidence; not fresh confirmation

population.selection: ascending salted SHA-256 among eligible released positive examples after excluding every Day 4 content hash
population.weighting: equal directions within example, equal examples within concept, equal concepts for the primary macro

excluded_concepts.deception: the pinned released pool was exhausted by Day 4
excluded_concepts.harmful: the pinned released pool was exhausted by Day 4

operator.definition: For each held-out target concept and response decile, use the unchanged Day 45 estimator of correct-trigger-minus-normal selected-head activity from all 64 original Day 4 positive development examples of that concept, with source-example contribution induced by its within-response decile fraction.
operator.target_exclusion: Every Day 47 target is content-disjoint from the entire source bank, so all 64 original examples contribute and no target-dependent recomputation occurs.

path: ordinary total path with layers 9 through 12 live

endpoints.primary: complete 13-probe mean raw-margin effect-vector recovery against exact natural K12 total-path effect on the same held-out example and direction
secondary: descriptive comparison with the sealed Day 46 existing-population total-path result

execution.dtype: bfloat16 model execution and float32 effects
execution.ordering: concept, then response token count, then example_id
execution.resumption: atomic batch shards with exact provenance and row keys

disposition.pass: Support the stereotyped additive-writer operation on content-disjoint released-data development examples and permit only a separately frozen upstream-controller and genuinely fresh-confirmation program.
disposition.fail: Reject held-out development validation of the compact operation, stop the rapid operation program, and retain the existing-population causal-write claim.

scope_boundary: No candidate, scale, source bank, example, concept, threshold, seed, probe, behavior test, or finer parameter analysis may change after outcomes. Passing is development evidence only and cannot earn the target title.
